definitions.explanation: A jump-rope technique in which the rope passes under the feet twice during a single jump. A staple skill children practice and compete at on the playground.

examples.japanese: {二重|にじゅう}{跳|と}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I managed to do a double under.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二重|にじゅう}{跳|と}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{十回|じゅっかい}⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: My little brother did ten double unders in a row.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}すれば→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、{二重|にじゅう}{跳|と}び⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: With practice, anyone can learn to do double unders.

notes:
A specific skill within ⟦{縄跳|なわと}び→縄跳び：06323_nawatobi⟧ (jump rope), where the rope makes two full rotations per jump.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二重|にじゅう}{跳|と}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to do a double under
- {二重|にじゅう}{跳|と}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧: to do a double under
- {二重|にじゅう}{跳|と}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: double-under practice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {三重|さんじゅう}{跳|と}び: triple under — three rope rotations per jump, a much harder variation
